entries.en: Improved VSCode extension command registry and sessions dialog user experience
entries.zh: 改进 VS Code 扩展的命令注册表和会话对话框的使用体验

entries.en: Enhanced sessions dialog responsiveness and visual feedback
entries.zh: 增强的会话对话响应能力和视觉反馈

entries.en: Fix input lag during typing, especially noticeable with large prompts
entries.zh: 修复打字期间的输入延迟，尤其是在出现较大提示时尤其明显

entries.en: Fixed IDE compatibility issue by removing worktree support check
entries.zh: 通过删除工作树支持检查修复了 IDE 兼容性问题

entries.en: Fixed security vulnerability where Bash tool permission checks could be bypassed using prefix matching
entries.zh: 修复了使用前缀匹配可以绕过 Bash 工具权限检查的安全漏洞
